name: How much does a whole-house renovation cost in San Diego if I want to update everything?

mainEntity.name: How much does a whole-house renovation cost in San Diego if I want to update everything?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no reliable one-size-fits-all price for renovating an entire house because scope, size, age, access, finishes, structural changes, and local requirements can alter the total substantially. A cosmetic refresh is fundamentally different from reconfiguring rooms, replacing systems, or adding square footage. Elite Remodeling & Design can develop a project-specific plan that connects the desired layout and finishes to construction requirements. Request a line-item estimate, allowances, exclusions, payment schedule, and change-order procedure rather than relying on a price per square foot alone.
acceptedAnswer.description: The price depends on house size, condition, layout changes, systems, finishes, access, and whether additions or conversions are included. Ask for a project-specific, line-item estimate showing allowances, exclusions, payment stages, and change-order rules instead of relying only on a square-foot figure.
